sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Primula stricta is a small arctic perennial, about 5–30 cm tall. It grows on shores, gravelly riverbanks and wet seepage areas.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Its narrow basal leaves are about 0.8–1.5 cm wide. A leafless stalk carries an umbel of two to eight lilac flowers with yellow throats. The dry capsule is about 3–4 × 2–3 mm.

sections.title: Comparison
sections.text: It belongs to a complex of closely related arctic primroses that can be difficult to distinguish. Unlike P. veris, it is a small arctic plant with narrow leaves and lilac flowers.
